name: L-Curve Regularization Parameter Selection
definition: Computes the solution norm $\|f_\alpha\|$ and residual norm $\|g - A f_\alpha\|$ across a range of regularization parameters $\alpha$ to identify the optimal trade-off point (the 'corner' of the L-curve).
summary: L-Curve Regularization Parameter Selection identifies the optimal trade-off between data fidelity and solution smoothness by locating the corner of a log-log plot of solution and residual norms, avoiding the need for direct error metrics.
